_comment: Verbatim transcription of the official NFL.com Week 10, 2026 injury report (source O01), captured
2026-11-12 UTC by session arena/e35b6c85-korea3. Every field is copied as printed on the official
page. An empty string means the official page printed an empty cell - it is NOT a missing value that
was filled in, and it must never be inferred later.
COVERAGE IS PARTIAL AND THIS IS RECORDED, NOT HIDDEN: 28 of 32 clubs appear below. DEN, CHI, PHI and
TB were not present in the page chunks this session retrieved. They are listed in coverage_gaps as
unverified rather than being assumed to be on bye or assumed to have no injuries.
player_url is the official NFL.com player page exactly as linked from the report row.
report_title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com

games._blank_reason: The kickoff time and broadcast for this game fell across a page-chunk boundary that this session did not retrieve. Left blank rather than copied from the neighbouring 4:05 PMEST slot. Flag D06.

designations._comment: Rows where the official report printed a NON-BLANK Game Status, or a NON-BLANK Injuries value. These are the only officially designated availability outcomes in the captured report. Every other captured row had both cells blank.

no_injuries_reported._comment: Clubs for which the official report printed the literal text 'No Injuries Reported'. Recorded verbatim. See contradictions.json: for CIN, SEA and LAC this is contradicted by other official NFL.com pages for the same week.

_comment: Every captured player row, with the practice status exactly as printed. The Injuries and Game Status
cells were BLANK on the official page for all of these rows, so they are stored as empty strings and
published as blanks. Injury detail for some of these players exists on O03 (the official Wednesday
roundup) and is published separately in injury_detail_from_roundup - the two are NOT merged into one
cell, because they are two different official publications and merging them would hide provenance.
Injury TYPES and roster moves taken from the official NFL.com Wednesday 11 November 2026 roundup (O03).
Only the eight club sections this session actually retrieved are transcribed: ARI, ATL, BAL, BUF, CAR,
CIN, CLE, DAL. The roundup's remaining club sections were in page chunks that could not be retrieved,
so those clubs have NO rows here - they are not assumed to be empty.
text is copied verbatim, including the source's own spelling error in the Jaelan Phillips line.

rows.text: QB Carson Beck will start Sunday's game against the Rams, per head coach Mike LaFleur. This will be Beck's first career start in the NFL after he was selected in the third round of the 2026 draft.
RB Bam Knight (concussion) was limited at Wednesday's practice.
TE Hunter Long (knee) was designated to return from injured reserve. Long was limited.
DL Zach Carter (knee) was designated to return from IR. Carter was limited.
WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring) did not practice on Wednesday.
OL Cameron Williams (ankle) was activated off injured reserve.
K Riley Patterson is signing with Baltimore following a workout and will kick for the Ravens during Monday's game against the Chargers, NFL Network Insider Mike Garafolo reported.
TE Dalton Kincaid (ankle) was limited at Wednesday's practice.
RB Jonathon Brooks (groin) designated to return from injured reserve. Brooks was a full participant on Wednesday.
WR Xavier Legette (knee) designated to return from IR. Legette was a full participant.

rows.verbatim_note: The official source prints 'hamtring'. Transcribed verbatim; not silently corrected. Flag D10.

rows.text: CB Mike Jackson (groin) designated to return from IR. Jackson was a full participant.
G Dylan Fairchild (pectoral) was limited at Wednesday's practice.
rows.link_note: The official source prints this player's name WITHOUT a hyperlink, unlike every other row in the same list. No official player URL was therefore available and none is invented. Flag D11.

rows.text: QB Deshaun Watson will start Sunday against the Texans, the team announced Wednesday. Watson cleared concussion protocol before Cleveland's Week 9 game but was inactive as Shedeur Sanders got the start in the loss to New Orleans. As of Monday, coach Todd Monken had not committed to a Week 10 starter.
WR Denzel Boston (toe) did not practice Wednesday but is expected to return Thursday, per Monken.
RB Tyler Goodson (ankle/knee) did not practice on Wednesday.

rows.truncation_note: The official page text was cut off mid-line at the page-chunk boundary. The practice status that followed '(ankle)' was NOT retrieved and is not published. Flag D12.

coverage_gaps._comment: Recorded rather than smoothed over. These clubs do not appear in the captured Week 10 report. A club-code variance between the official report and the repository dataset is recorded under coverage_gaps.club_code_variance (flag D18).
coverage_gaps.note: Whether these four clubs are on bye, whether their games were not yet listed, or whether their rows fell in an unretrieved page chunk is NOT KNOWN and is not inferred. Flag D05. A re-fetch of the full report is required before this dataset may be treated as complete.

club_code_variance._comment: Recorded verbatim, not normalised away. The official Week 10 injury report (O01) prints two different club codes from the ones used by the repository's historical game dataset (data/games_1999_2026_nflverse.csv, which is a third-party-derived dataset, not an official publisher). Both forms are official-or-dataset spellings of the same club, but joining the two files on the club code alone silently drops Arizona and the Los Angeles Rams. No official crosswalk table was consulted, so the mapping below is a DECLARED alias for the coverage gate in decision_lab/check.py only. It is status unverified: it is not evidence, it is a join instruction. Flag D18.
club_code_variance.compared_against: data/games_1999_2026_nflverse.csv (tier: dataset, not an official publisher)

roster_status_probe.conclusion: NFL.com publishes roster membership and a status code per player, but publishes NO first/second/third/fourth-string ordering. The depth string required by the brief is therefore not obtainable from this official publisher and is left blank everywhere in this directory.
